request.style: English, Female solo voice, melancholic and haunting, acoustic guitar, cello, piano, soft percussion, minor key, 70 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
You trusted in your beauty and played the whore
Lavished your favors on every passerby
Took garments and made gaudy shrines for them
Used my gold and silver to make male images
Set my oil and incense before these idols
Sacrificed your sons and daughters to the fire
Did not remember the days of your youth
When you were naked and kicking in your blood

[Chorus]
Hear the word of the Lord regarding you
I will gather all your lovers against you
Strip you naked before them in the square
They will tear down your mound and lofty shrines
Stone you and cut you with their swords
I will spend my wrath and my jealousy
Then I will be calm and no longer angry

[Verse]
You built a mound at the head of every street
Degraded your beauty for every passerby
Played the whore with the Egyptians and Assyria
Multiplied your whorings with Chaldea too
You scorned payment like a brazen prostitute
Opposite of women who solicited love
You are truly your mother's daughter indeed
Who despised her husband and her children

[Chorus]
Hear the word of the Lord regarding you
I will gather all your lovers against you
Strip you naked before them in the square
They will tear down your mound and lofty shrines
Stone you and cut you with their swords
I will spend my wrath and my jealousy
Then I will be calm and no longer angry

[Bridge]
Your older sister Samaria lived to the north
Your younger sister Sodom lived to the south
You copied their abominations and ways
Became more corrupt in all your deeds
Sodom was arrogant and overfed with ease
Did not help the poor and the needy
Samaria did not commit half your sins
You made your sisters look righteous by contrast

[Outro]
I will restore the fortunes of them all
So you may bear your disgrace and be ashamed
They will return to their former state
And you will be a consolation to them
